title: 第七章 洗劫敌人仓库，我富得流油-《无CP废土：基建养出全》
content:
第(1/3)页

    一、风声

    震动更近了。林霜掌心贴着地面，数车轮碾过的频率。

    “系统，更新车辆数量。“

    “扫描中……先头车队五辆装甲车，后续增援十辆改装越野车，总计十五辆，每车8-12人，约一百五十人。距离四公里，正在减速，疑似准备扎营。“

    林霜眼底一凝。五辆变十五辆——药厂逃回去的人报了信，收割者增兵了。

    “苏琳。“她声音压得极低，字字冷硬如钉，“起来，我们立刻搬家。“

    苏琳没睡着，听到动静就睁了眼。手摸向砍刀——昨夜被抓时她把砍刀塞进碎石堆藏好，回来时还完好无损。左腿还肿着，但林霜昨夜给她重新固定的层板起了效，骨裂处没有错位，肿胀也没继续恶化。

    “搬去哪？“苏琳撑着墙面坐起。

    “这地下室待不住了。“林霜已经动手收拾物资，动作利落干脆，“一百五十人，不是冲我们来的。但他们扎营后，会清场。这片废墟，迟早被翻个底朝天。“

    “可放眼四周全是断壁残垣，我们去哪找第二个藏身点？“

    林霜停下动作，转头看向她，眼神平静却透着一股孤绝。

    “不能等他们发现我们。趁他们扎营混乱，去摸点物资回来。“

    苏琳愣住，以为自己听错。

    “你说什么？“

    “收割者车队刚从药厂过来，整车满载药品、医疗设备、稀缺物资。安营之后，只会留少量人手看守，大部队必然外出清场搜掠、补充给养。“

    林霜一边在地图上快速划线，思路清晰缜密，“他们笃定这片区域没有能抗衡的势力，留守守卫顶多十几个人。我们要做的，就是趁他们刚扎营、主力尚未外出的空档，摸进去，搬物资，立刻撤离。“

    “打住！“苏琳伸手按住地图，脸色凝重，“你清醒点！留守的估计十几个人，但他们有自动步枪，我们近身就是送死！“

    “不是硬拼，是潜行偷盗。“林霜抬眸，眼神静得像一潭寒水，“不正面交锋，借着夜色掩体摸进物资区，挑最刚需的物资速拿速退。“

    “你怎么确定物资堆放点？怎么摸清守卫换班规律？又怎么拿捏他们主力外出的时间？“

    “不确定。“林霜折好地图揣进内兜，起身拎起石斧，“先摸清他们扎在哪。跟我来。“

    苏琳盯着她沉默五秒，缓缓吐出一口浊气，无奈又佩服。

    “你这人最大的毛病，就是从不给自己留退路，好像什么绝境都能硬趟过去。“

    “不是自负，是没得选。“林霜语气淡淡，“收割者扎根这片区域，等于和铁锤帮彻底绑定合作。往后掠夺者巡逻只会越来越密，地下室早晚会被翻出来。与其坐以待毙挨枪子，不如趁他们立足未稳，先下手为强。“

    苏琳张了张嘴，想说这是强盗逻辑，话到嘴边却又咽了回去。

    废土之上，活下去，本身就是最硬核的道理。

    “我的腿，能走短距离。“苏琳拄紧钢管，慢慢挪步，左腿轻点地面试探力道，骨裂处依旧刺痛，好在没有错位二次损伤，“三公里以内能撑，再远就得停。跑，完全跑不了。“

    “不用狂奔，甩开追兵足够。“

    两人即刻打包地下室所有家当：食物、净水、药品、武器、工具，能带走的一件不落。带不走的木板、铁链、电线尽数拆散，堆在角落覆满灰尘碎石，伪装成早已废弃的破败角落。

    苏琳背起塞满干粮饮水的双肩包，林霜扛着原料药袋，手握石斧，腰间别满刀械。

    最后看了一眼这间住了五天的地下室。

    五天前萍水相逢，如今已是废土里生死相托的同伴。

    “走。“

    二、暗处

    收割者车队最终停在距离地下室四公里外的废弃厂区空地。

    两人穿行废墟沟壑、废弃工地，整整四十分钟，一路隐蔽潜行。厂区北边有栋塌了一半的楼，还剩六层，能爬。

    两人伏在窗台，拿出破旧望远镜悄然观察。

    厂区占地开阔，一大一小两栋厂房，外加一座大型仓库。收割者越野车围成环形车阵，居中空地堆满从药厂搬来的木箱、塑料桶、金属罐，盖上防水布，物资码得整整齐齐。

    营地里人影攒动。

    林霜举起望远镜，借着火光仔细观察营地布局，同时在脑海中询问系统：“标记我看到的所有热源位置。“

    “标记中。A厂房方向：热源信号10个；B厂房方向：热源信号15个；车场方向：热源信号20个；其余分散在帐篷区，约75个。总计约一百二十个可见热源，其余可能在遮蔽物后方。“

    “物资全都堆在B厂房内？“

    “B厂房是原来的仓库，单层，空间大，适合堆东西。设一处主入口、两处侧门，四周皆有守卫值守，内部照明充足。“

    林霜放下望远镜，闭目凝神，脑海里快速勾勒出B厂房的三维结构。

    八百平米空间，一主两侧三道门，十五名守卫，灯火通明，看似密不透风，实则必有死角。

    “苏琳，你看北侧。“她把望远镜递过去，指向厂房后方，“那里有一处一米见方的排风口，百叶锈蚀大半，已然破损，刚好能容一人钻入。外面背靠废墟残墙，遮挡充足，是绝佳潜入点。“

    “钻进去又如何？十五个守卫在里面来回巡逻，我们进去就是瓮中之鳖。“

    “厂房堆满物资木箱，遮挡死角极多。只要动作够快，趁守卫视线盲区搜刮刚需物资，得手立刻原路撤离。“

    苏琳透过望远镜仔细打量排风口，又扫视外围巡逻路线，沉吟片刻：“有几成把握？“

    “四成。“

    “四成你也敢闯？“

    “废土求生，四成胜算，已经是天大的奢侈。“林霜从窗台滑坐落地，背靠残墙休整，“等天黑入夜。篝火车灯照不远，夜色就是最好的掩护。“

    苏琳也跟着坐下，两人隔着一堆随身物资相对而坐。

    “你以前……也这么潜进去过？“苏琳忽然开口。

    “嗯。“林霜沉默片刻，难得愿意多说几句，“战区里，三次。两次把人带出来了，一次没成。那次之后，我就不带人了。“

    “都成功了？“

    “两次成，一次败。“她语气毫无波澜，听不出情绪，“失败那次，死了六个人。两名人质，四个同伴。“

    苏琳没有追问难过与否。她看得出来，这人从不是不悲伤，只是把所有软肋都死死压在心底，用极致的冷静和理智裹得严严实实。

    “这次不会败。“苏琳笃定开口。

1. Wind sound

The vibrations came closer.Lin Shuang put her palms against the ground and counted how often the wheels ran over her.

"System, update the number of vehicles."

"Scanning... The leading convoy consists of five armored vehicles, followed by ten modified off-road vehicles as reinforcements, for a total of fifteen vehicles, with 8-12 people per vehicle, about 150 people. It is four kilometers away and is slowing down. It is suspected that it is preparing to set up camp. "

Lin Shuang’s eyes condensed.Five vehicles turned into fifteen – the people who fled back from the pharmaceutical factory reported the news, and the reapers increased their troops.

"Su Lin." Her voice was extremely low, and her words were as cold as nails, "Get up, we will move immediately."

Su Lin was not asleep and opened her eyes when she heard the movement.Her hand reached for the machete - when she was caught last night, she stuffed the machete into the rubble and hid it, and it was still intact when she came back.Her left leg was still swollen, but the laminate that Lin Shuang refixed for her last night took effect. The fractured bone was not dislocated, and the swelling did not worsen.

"Where to move?" Su Lin sat up and supported the wall.

"We can't stay in this basement anymore." Lin Shuang had already started to pack up the supplies, and his movements were crisp and clear. "One hundred and fifty people are not here for us. But after they set up camp, they will clear the place. Sooner or later, this ruins will be turned upside down."

"But looking at the ruins all around, where can we find a second hiding spot?"

Lin Shuang stopped moving and turned to look at her, her eyes calm but showing a sense of loneliness.

"We can't wait for them to find us. While they are camping in chaos, go get some supplies and come back."

Su Lin was stunned, thinking she heard wrongly.

"What did you say?"

"The Reaper convoy has just arrived from the pharmaceutical factory. The entire vehicle is loaded with medicines, medical equipment, and scarce supplies. After setting up camp, only a small number of manpower will be left to guard it. The large force will definitely go out to clear the area, loot and replenish supplies. "

Lin Shuang quickly drew lines on the map, thinking clearly and carefully, "They are sure that there is no force in this area that can compete, and there are at most a dozen guards left behind. What we have to do is to take advantage of the gap where they have just set up camp and the main force has not yet gone out, get in, move supplies, and evacuate immediately."

"Stop!" Su Lin stretched out her hand to hold down the map, with a solemn expression, "Please wake up! There are probably more than a dozen people left behind, but they have automatic rifles. If we get close, we will die!"

"It's not a head-on fight, it's a sneaky theft." Lin Shuang raised his eyes, his eyes as calm as a pool of cold water, "Instead of a head-on confrontation, use the cover of the night to sneak into the supply area, pick out the most needed supplies, and get out quickly."

"How do you determine the storage point for supplies? How do you figure out the guard shift schedule? And how do you determine the time when their main force goes out?"

"Not sure." Lin Shuang folded the map and put it in his inner pocket. He stood up and picked up the stone axe. "First find out where they are. Follow me."

Su Lin stared at her in silence for five seconds, then slowly exhaled a breath of helplessness and admiration.

"The biggest problem with you is that you never leave yourself a way out. You seem to be able to push through any desperate situation."

"It's not that you are conceited, it's that you have no choice." Lin Shuang said indifferently, "The Reaper's presence in this area means that it is completely bound to cooperate with the Hammer Gang. In the future, the raider patrols will only become more and more intensive, and sooner or later the basement will be dug out. Instead of sitting back and waiting to be shot, it is better to strike first while their foothold is not stable."

Su Lin opened her mouth, wanting to say that this was gangster logic, but she swallowed the words when she reached her lips.

" Surviving in the wasteland is the most hard-core principle in itself.

"My legs can walk short distances." Su Lin held on to the steel pipe tightly and moved slowly. She tapped her left leg lightly on the ground to test her strength. The fractured bone still hurt, but fortunately there was no secondary damage from the dislocation. "I can hold it within three kilometers, but I have to stop if it goes further. I can't run at all."

“There’s no need to run wildly, it’s enough to get rid of the pursuers.”

The two men immediately packed up all the belongings in the basement: food, clean water, medicine, weapons, tools, leaving nothing behind.All the wooden boards, chains, and wires that could not be taken away were dismantled and piled in the corner covered with dust and gravel, pretending to be a dilapidated corner that had long been abandoned.

Su Lin carried a backpack filled with dry food and water, while Lin Shuang carried a bag of raw materials, holding a stone ax in his hand and a belt full of knives.

I took one last look at the basement where I had lived for five days.

We met by chance five days ago, and now we are companions who depend on each other for life and death in the wasteland.

"Let's go."

2. Dark place

The Reaper convoy finally stopped in an abandoned factory area four kilometers away from the basement.

The two walked through ruins, ravines, and abandoned construction sites for a full forty minutes, sneaking stealthily along the way.There is a half-collapsed building on the north side of the factory, with six floors left that can be climbed.

The two of them leaned on the window sill and took out old telescopes to observe quietly.

The factory covers an open area, with two factory buildings, one large and one small, plus a large warehouse.The Reaper off-road vehicles formed a circular formation, and the open space in the middle was filled with wooden boxes, plastic barrels, and metal cans brought from the pharmaceutical factory. They were covered with tarpaulins and the materials were neatly stacked.

The camp was full of people.

Lin Shuang raised the telescope and carefully observed the layout of the camp by the light of the fire. At the same time, he asked the system in his mind: "Mark the locations of all the heat sources I see."

"Marking. Direction of factory A: 10 heat source signals; direction of factory B: 15 heat source signals; direction of parking lot: 20 heat source signals; the rest are scattered in the tent area, about 75. There are about one hundred and twenty visible heat sources in total, and the rest may be behind the shelter."

"Are all the materials piled up in Factory B?"

“Factory Building B is the original warehouse, with a single floor and a large space, suitable for stacking things. There is a main entrance and two side doors. There are guards on all sides and there is sufficient lighting inside. "

Lin Shuang put down the telescope, closed her eyes and concentrated, quickly sketching the three-dimensional structure of Factory B in her mind.

​​ 800 square meters of space, one main door with three doors on both sides, fifteen guards, brightly lit, it seems airtight, but in fact there must be dead ends.

"Su Lin, look at the north side." She handed over the binoculars and pointed to the back of the factory building. "There is a one-meter-square exhaust vent there. The shutters are mostly rusted and damaged, and it is just big enough for one person to get in. The outside is backed by a ruined wall and has enough cover, making it an excellent sneaking point."

"So what if we get in? Fifteen guards are patrolling back and forth inside. If we go in, we will be the turtle in the urn."

"The factory building is filled with wooden boxes of supplies, and there are many blind spots. As long as you move quickly enough, you can use the blind spots of the guards' sight to search for the supplies you need, and you can evacuate immediately. "

Su Lin carefully looked at the air outlet through the telescope, then scanned the outer patrol route, and pondered for a moment: "How sure are you?"

"Forty percent."

"You dare to break through 40%?"

"Surviving in the wasteland, with a 40% chance of winning, is already a huge luxury." Lin Shuang slid down from the window sill and rested with his back against the broken wall. "Wait until it gets dark. The bonfire train lights are not far away, and the night is the best cover."

Su Lin also sat down, and the two sat opposite each other with a pile of belongings.

"Have you ever...sneaked in like this before?" Su Lin suddenly said.

"Yes." Lin Shuang was silent for a moment, rarely willing to say more, "Three times in the war zone. Twice I brought people out, but once I failed. After that time, I stopped taking people."

"Everything was successful?"

"Twice succeeded, once failed." Her tone was calm and emotionless, "The time we failed, six people died. Two hostages and four companions."

Su Lin didn’t ask whether she was sad or not.She could see that this person was never sad, he just suppressed all his weaknesses in his heart and wrapped them tightly with extreme calmness and reason.

"We won't lose this time." Su Lin said firmly.
